name: provider-router
description: Route model requests by model-id prefix (anthropic:, openai:, zai:, custom:) to other providers, while unprefixed models stay on your Claude subscription.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Key for openai: models. Overrides env OPENAI_API_KEY.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic Platform API key
anthropicApiKey.description: Key for anthropic: models. Overrides env ROUTER_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

zaiApiKey.title: Z.ai API key
zaiApiKey.description: Key for zai: models. Overrides env ZAI_API_KEY.

customEndpoints.title: Custom endpoints
customEndpoints.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoints as name=url, used as custom:<name>:<model>. Keys from env ROUTER_CUSTOM_API_KEYS (name=key,...).

contextWindows.title: Context windows
contextWindows.description: Extra context windows as model=tokens, e.g. openai:my-model=128000.
